summary: SAML 'role_membership' attribute sent as UTF-16LE CSV (with BOM) causes RBAC parser to ignore roles in Private deployment
summary_short: UTF16LE BOM in role attribute leads to missing role-bindings
description:
Issue summary:
Kepler Finance reports that since yesterday evening, a subset of service accounts and scheduled workers in their private Redwood deployment lose admin-level RBAC bindings and receive 403s when calling admin APIs. Our gateway logs show assertions without parsed role entries.

Impact:
- Several scheduled jobs failed (backfill and ingestion processes) leading to delayed processing for ~10K messages. Customer-facing: internal admin console inaccessible to a small ops team; no user-facing inference impact.

Environment:
- Private deployment (on-prem appliance) behind customer ingress
- Region: eu-west
- Redwood version: private-agent v1.14.3
- Proxy: custom NGINX sidecar (TLS passthrough)

Steps to reproduce:
1) Customer authenticates via SAML SSO (IdP: AuthSuite v3.2)
2) IdP includes attribute 'role_membership' with value sent as a CSV string encoded in UTF-16LE with BOM (0xFF 0xFE)
3) Request reaches private-idp-proxy which forwards assertion to auth service
4) RBAC parser expects UTF-8 CSV; BOM/UTF-16LE causes parser to treat whole blob as single token and role split fails

Observed logs (snippets):
- proxy-auth.log: "Assertion received: role_membership=[\uFEFFAdmin,Editor]"
- rbac-service WARN: "role parser: unable to split attribute, raw_len=24"
- audit.log (customer): "user=svc-scheduler-01 action=admin.job.submit result=DENIED reason=missing_role"

Initial hypothesis:
- IdP is emitting non-UTF8 encoding for that attribute; our parser lacks graceful fallback and the split by ',' fails when BOM present
- Edge proxy may not normalize character encoding for assertion body

Related artifacts:
- customer-provided SAML response (redacted) uploaded to ticket attachments
- Slack thread: #support-kepler (link: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C0KEPLER/12345)
steps_to_reproduce: IdP issues SAML with role_membership encoded UTF-16LE BOM
Authenticate via SSO in private deployment with customer ingress
Observe RBAC parser logs and audit denies
logs: rbac-service WARN: "role parser: unable to split attribute, raw_len=24"
investigation_notes: Verified SAML assertion encoding using hexdump: leading bytes 0xFF 0xFE indicate UTF-16LE BOM
Reproduced locally by crafting assertion with UTF-16LE CSV; RBAC parser returned single token 'ï»¿Admin,Editor' on our UTF-8 path
Private-idp-proxy currently forwards assertion bytes untouched; no normalization step exists

Team hypothesis: fast fix could be to normalize assertion attribute values to UTF-8 and strip BOM before CSV split; longer-term add unit tests for encoding edgecases and add alerting when attribute parse returns single token for multi-role attributes
comments: 2026-03-10 20:12 - Aisha Raman: Customer reports all scheduled ingestion workers started failing after a credential rotation. Provided redacted SAML response.
2026-03-10 21:05 - Marcus Chen: Reproduced parsing failure locally by sending a UTF-16LE encoded role attribute. Filing as P1 due to production denial of admin ops.
2026-03-11 09:15 - Kepler Support (customer): We can change IdP config but it is managed by central SSO team; request if Redwood can tolerate BOMs for compatibility.
2026-03-11 11:40 - Marcus Chen: Temporary mitigation script proposed: pre-process assertion in proxy to normalize encodings and strip BOMs. Need SRE approval for private-agent change.
2026-03-12 08:32 - SRE Oncall (Lena Becker): Approved limited change to private-agent to add encoding normalization flag behind feature toggle for Kepler cluster.
resolution: In Progress - feature toggle implemented in private-agent v1.14.4-ktfix that normalizes assertion attribute encodings (UTF-16LE/BE -> UTF-8) and strips BOMs prior to RBAC parsing. Deployed to Kepler's eu-west cluster under feature flag. Confirmed scheduled workers resumed and admin APIs succeed. Plan: backport to 1.14.x branch and add unit tests; customer to coordinate with IdP team for long-term fix.
